{{Quote|Jake's been running guns and food and all sorts of stuff ever since he was old enough to pilot a ship.|[[Ezil]]|<ref name="Life in the Shadows">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20020307bshadows&c=swlfc|text=Life in the Shadows}}</ref>}}
'''Jake''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
At a young age, Jake began working as a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] runner, transporting food and arms to besieged [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Originally, he worked with other smugglers and flew a variety of different [[Starship/Legends|starships]], but eventually he made enough money to start working independently. At some point, Jake made his way to the planet Cularin and began taking jobs from the local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]], as well as other people. He also became an associate of the playboy [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Xav Verivax]].
